laws.rule: Lahemaa National Park: camping and campfires only at official marked sites; leave camps tidy, use fallen branches only and make sure the fire is out. Non-motorised boats on rivers and Lake Käsmu; boats without combustion engines on other lakes. Public events need Environmental Board consent (from 10 participants in most places in strict nature zones, 50 at prepared sites). Fishing is banned year-round on several rivers and within 100 m downstream of dams. Do not damage trees, nests or protected objects or disturb residents' home peace.
laws.heading: Lahemaa National Park

laws.rule: Visit Tallinn (the city's tourism site, article dated 21 July 2026) says drinking alcohol in public is forbidden in Tallinn, including city streets, parks, public transport and its waiting areas.
laws.heading: Visit Tallinn, Nightlife in Tallinn

laws.rule: The same page gives quiet hours of 10 pm to 6 am, and from midnight to 7 am on nights before rest days. In public spaces it is forbidden to make noise or produce light effects that might significantly disturb others. Police can issue a fine or make an arrest if residents complain; the page gives no amounts.
laws.heading: Visit Tallinn, Nightlife in Tallinn
